author: jabclaw1-gif
name: Shot Printer
description: Prints the shot graph and shot details on a network (ESC/POS) receipt printer after every shot, or on demand.

PrinterHost.label: Printer IP address
PrinterHost.description: IP address or hostname of the receipt printer on your network, for example 192.168.1.50. Most printers print it on a self-test page (hold the feed button while switching on).

PrinterPort.label: Printer port
PrinterPort.description: Raw printing port. Almost every network receipt printer uses 9100.

PaperWidth.label: Paper width
PaperWidth.description: Width of the receipt paper roll.

AutoPrint.label: Print every shot automatically
AutoPrint.description: Print a receipt as soon as each shot is saved. Turn off to print only from the preview page.

MinShotSeconds.label: Minimum shot length
MinShotSeconds.description: Shots shorter than this many seconds (flushes, aborted shots) are not printed automatically.

HeaderText.label: Header text
HeaderText.description: Optional line printed large at the top, such as your cafe name.

FooterText.label: Footer text
FooterText.description: Optional line printed at the bottom of the receipt.

ShowTargets.label: Show target curves
ShowTargets.description: Also draw the profile's pressure and flow targets as thin dotted lines.

CutPaper.label: Cut paper
CutPaper.description: Cut the paper after printing. Turn off for printers without a cutter.
